terminals.note: use it (interact) within radius: opens the gates in 'activates'

risers.note: the arena starts under the liquid; its platforms surge up in order when a player enters the trigger sphere - goofy: see assembly.goofy_pose

saws.note: joint k turns its group and every later one about axis through its own pivot by amp_k sin(2 pi (t + phase) / period - lag_k) degrees; the spin group also turns rpm about the axis through the blade centre; kill within radius of the blade centre and 0.7 m of its plane (normal = axis)

belts.note: a body standing on the deck (within width / length, feet within 0.4 m of it) moves speed * axis m/s

drive.note: press_profile(): u = (t + phase) mod period; ram offset -travel (u/slam)^2, held, eased back over rise; each stage moves offset * frac; rotor angle = whole-turn cycles + spin-up / peak / coast-down from the impact; the head's glow blinks for 'warn' s before each slam; camera shake within 'shake' m on impact

sweepers.note: angle(t) = arm + rpm * 6 * t deg (level yaw convention: direction (sin, cos)); a bar kills a body it overlaps (jump over it), a ball kills within ball_r

lifts.note: stand on it 'wait' s -> it travels (smoothstep, 'duration' s) to the other end; a player in a call zone brings it to that end when it is empty; carries whoever stands on it
